sections.title: Quick start
sections.body: First steps: configure the network, check outputs, configure LED strings, connect KNX/BAOS, create a backup, then test scenes or flows.

sections.title: Outputs / LED strings
sections.body: Configure the board outputs here. Disabled outputs keep their settings but are not driven physically.

sections.title: KNX / BAOS
sections.body: KNX objects connect the controller to group addresses and BAOS datapoints. Fixed object numbers should only be changed deliberately after ETS setup.

sections.title: Update firmware and help
sections.body: Firmware updates and help files are downloaded separately. The built-in help remains available offline.

fields.label: Active
fields.short: Enables or disables one LED output logically.
fields.details: Disabled keeps the values stored, but the output is not passed to the LED backend.

fields.label: Pixels
fields.short: Number of LEDs on the physical string.
fields.details: This must match the real LED count for effects, power estimates and tests to work correctly.

fields.label: Manual tests active
fields.short: Number of currently running manual color or edge tests.
fields.details: 0 means no output is currently overridden by a manual test.
